default/32292.htm.text: Galate: Salutations; I am Galate, and I have been charged by the Ivory Tower to investigate a possible connection between the Isle of Prayer and Hellbound Isle. We will have answers at last! Priest Kanis on the Isle of Prayer knows the secret for entering Hellbound; go meet him.

Q00130_PathToHellbound/32292-01.html.text: Galate: What brings you here? If you have nothing to say, please do not bother me.

links.text: "I want to know how to get to Hellbound."

Q00130_PathToHellbound/32292-04.html.text: Galate: Go see Elder Casian and bring back his Blue Crystal . Otherwise, just admit that you lied to me.

Q00130_PathToHellbound/32292-05.html.text: Galate: Did you bring the Blue Crystal from Elder Casian?

Q00133_ThatsBloodyHot/32292-01.html.text: Galate: What's the matter? Please don't interrupt if you have no business with me. I'm occupied with very sensitive and important research at the moment.

Q00133_ThatsBloodyHot/32292-02.html.text: Galate: What's the matter? Please don't interrupt if you have no business with me. I'm occupied with very sensitive and important research at the moment.

Q00133_ThatsBloodyHot/32292-04.html.text: Galate: Hmm, what have we here? Oh, well, this certainly proves you are who you say you are, doesn't it? I'm sorry to have doubted you, but I'm sure you understand my predicament. Still, only a priest at a crystal oracle could craft a refined crystal sample like this.

links.text: I heard that there's a way to get onto Hellbound Island without Beleth detecting it.

Q00130_PathToHellbound/32292-02.html.text: Galate: Why are you asking me? I don't know anything about that!

links.text: "Elder Casian mentioned your name to me."

Q00130_PathToHellbound/32292-03.html.text: Galate: Elder Casian? If you really came here on Elder Casian's instructions, go visit him and bring me his Blue Crystal . Simply mentioning his name won't get you very far with me...

Q00130_PathToHellbound/32292-06.html.text: Galate: Well, if Elder Casian is willing to entrust this to you, I suppose I can trust you as well.

links.text: "Is there a way to enter Hellbound?"

Q00130_PathToHellbound/32292-07.html.text: Galate: Yes... If you insert the Blue Crystal into this magic device next to me and activate it, you can teleport to Hellbound Island. One moment... (Galate inserts the Blue Crystal.) Ah, you may now proceed to Hellbound!

Q00133_ThatsBloodyHot/32292-03.html.text: Galate: Oh, you're here for Kanis, are you? My apologies, but can I know that for sure? My enemies would stop at nothing to get what I'm working on at the moment, and I really can't be too careful...

links.text: Give the refined crystal samples from Kanis.

If you inject the energy from the refined crystal sample you just gave me into this magical equipment and activate it, you will be able to teleport to Hellbound Island without Beleth knowing.
